tagline: We tap every button so your users never find the broken one
intro: Pocket QA tests mobile apps and websites by hand, on real phones. We go through sign-up, onboarding, payments and every screen in between, and send you a friendly list of what broke and how to see it break.
audience: Start-ups and small product studios across Portugal, Spain and the rest of Europe, from a first app in beta to apps with a few hundred thousand downloads.
pricing_note: A flat price per test round, agreed after we have seen your app. Teams releasing every couple of weeks usually take a monthly plan with a round per release.

services.title: Test rounds
services.description: Send us a build and a deadline. We tap through the whole app on a set of real phones and send back a list of issues with screenshots and steps.

services.title: Beta check-ups
services.description: Before you open your beta, we play your first users: install, sign up, get lost, come back the next day. You hear about the rough edges first.

services.title: Store release checks
services.description: The day before an app store release, we run the journeys that matter on the new build, so nothing obvious slips out with the update.

services.title: Phone and tablet coverage
services.description: Small screens, big screens, old phones, dark mode, larger text sizes. We check that your app still makes sense on all of them.

process.title: Send us your app
process.description: Share a test build or a link, tell us what the app is for and which journeys you care about most. We reply with a plan and a price.

process.title: We tap through it
process.description: Our testers work through every journey on real phones and tablets, writing up each issue with steps, screenshots and the device.

process.title: You fix, we recheck
process.description: You get a friendly report and a short call. When the fixes are in, we tap through those journeys again and mark them passed.

proof.text: They found the onboarding bug on small Android phones the week before our launch.
The reports are clear enough that our designers read them too.
proof.source: Product designer, a Barcelona fitness studio app (sample)

proof.text: Quick, thorough and genuinely nice to work with.
